author: ctaen
quote:
My old review has been silently deleted (probably because they can't handle the truth and some harsh words) and there wasn't even a hint that it got deleted, or why (nor did I get an email). Luckily I always add a log entry on where and what I posted, because this happens on countless platforms.

Anyways the game in a few words without any story spoilers and "swearing": woke, 30 FPS, buggy, feeling like you're playing The SIMS, no freedom of action, you're constantly being held back because of "superior morality".

Honestly I think the whole reason why the user rating is above 5 is because they delete many negative reviews if they have the slightest hint of swearing (even though this has to be tolerated in the name of freedom of speech). So you, the reader, probably know exactly what I, in reality, really want to say about this game.
